.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c @'
import sys,json
from fractions import Fraction as F
from itertools import product
from math import comb
sys.path.insert(0,'experiments/dependence_delay_linear')
from calibrated_flip_construction_audit import stationary_risk
pi,pj,gamma,eta,w=F(1,4),F(3,8),F(1,2),F(1,4),F(1,100)
m,n=1,2
EX=EZ=EXZ=EX2=EZ2=F(0)
for own in product((0,1),repeat=m+n):
    for donor in product((0,1),repeat=m+n):
        prob=pi**sum(own)*(1-pi)**(m+n-sum(own))*pj**sum(donor)*(1-pj)**(m+n-sum(donor))
        X=F(sum(own),m+n)
        Z=F(sum(donor[m:])-sum(own[m:]),n)-F(sum(donor[:m])-sum(own[:m]),m)
        EX+=prob*X; EZ+=prob*Z; EXZ+=prob*X*Z
        EX2+=prob*X*X; EZ2+=prob*Z*Z
cov=EXZ-EX*EZ
vi,vj=pi*(1-pi),pj*(1-pj)
assert cov==0 and EZ==0
assert EX2-EX*EX+w*w*EZ2==vi/(m+n)+w*w*(vi+vj)*(F(1,m)+F(1,n))
for t in range(1,9):
    true=1/(1-gamma+2*gamma*pi)
    risk=sum(comb(t,k)*pi**k*(1-pi)**(t-k)*(1/(1-gamma+2*gamma*F(k,t))-true)**2 for k in range(t+1))
    assert risk<=(2*gamma/(1-gamma)**2)**2*vi/t
a=1-gamma+2*gamma*pi
s=4*gamma*gamma*vi
exact=-2*s*eta*(2*a-eta*a*a)/(a*a*(2*a-eta*(a*a+s))**2)
h=F(1,10**8)
num=(stationary_risk(pi,pj,gamma,eta,h,1)-stationary_risk(pi,pj,gamma,eta,-h,1))/(2*h)
assert abs(num-exact)<F(1,10**12)
print(json.dumps({'kind':'independent_exact_proof_checks_not_efficacy','split_covariance':str(cov),'split_variance_identity':True,'local_plugin_bound_checks':8,'derivative_absolute_difference':float(abs(num-exact))},sort_keys=True))
